    import collections
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        a = list(map(int, input[index + 1].split()))
        index += 2
        counter = Counter(a)
        max_freq = max(counter.values())
        if max_freq > (n + 1) // 2:
            results.append(-1)
        else:
            freqs = sorted((freq, tag) for tag, freq in counter.items())
            order = []
            for freq, tag in reversed(freqs):
                order.extend([tag] * freq)
            cost = 0
            last_tag = None
            for i in range(n):
                if last_tag == order[i]:
                    cost += 1
                    for j in range(i + 1, n):
                        if order[j] != last_tag:
                            order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
                            break
                last_tag = order[i]
            results.append(cost)
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))

main()
